name: Courting the Crown
source:
Life as heir to the throne of Arvore has always been peaceful, until a violent attack on the castle changes everything. Now as your unexpected coronation looms, you must seek the support of Arvore's greatest allies. But could one of these allies have been responsible for the attack? And is marriage the only way to truly solidify an alliance? With the help of your cunning advisor, devoted best friend, and the mysterious palace wizard, you must decide who can be trusted before it's too late...

[From [url=https://fictif.fandom.com/wiki/Courting_the_Crown]FictIf Wiki[/url]]
translation:
作为阿尔沃尔王位继承人的生活一直很平静，直到对城堡的暴力袭击改变了一切。现在，当你意想不到的加冕典礼临近时，你必须寻求阿尔沃最伟大盟友的支持。但这些盟友之一是否可能对这次袭击负责？婚姻是真正巩固联盟的唯一途径吗？在狡猾的顾问、忠诚的好朋友和神秘的宫殿巫师的帮助下，你必须在为时已晚之前决定谁可以信任……

[来自[url=https://fictif.fandom.com/wiki/Courting_the_Crown]FictIf Wiki[/url]]
